note: Voiceover for the v2 promo. Each line starts at an on-screen moment ('anchor') plus 'offset' seconds; a line is pushed later if the previous one is still talking.

lines.text: You vibe-coded your app in a weekend. Nice. But is it secure?
Paste your URL into Secure Vibes. We scan it the way attackers do.
Gemma 4 reads the results and tells you, in plain English, what to fix first.
Open admin ports. Leaked usernames. Email anyone can spoof. Every risk, with the fix.
Then you get your own security briefing video. Send it to your co-founder, or your investors.
Hit Fix my vibe. You shipped fast. Now ship secure, with Secure Vibes.
